bio: You don't even need to step inside to realise that Nr.12 is the hippest restaurant on Grote Markt. It also serves the most delicious food! Veteran chef Frédéric Helsen is a dab hand at rustling up dishes to share (of which we wager you will order too many, so vast is the choice!). He puts his own playful yet fuss-free spin on classic recipes to delight our taste buds. Think succulent boudin blanc with a subtle madeira sauce, or pan-fried plaice with crab and a rich beurre blanc: the menu is sure to make any foodie's heart race. Craving more? Chef Helsen's vending machine (Meidoornlaan 1, Herentals) is open seven days a week....
